description: (Recommended first tool for wallets) Overview of a Sui wallet: every coin balance, SuiNS name, staked SUI and kiosk counts, 50 newest transactions with an older-history continuation, and a time-bounded scan of package versions it published or upgraded in the first 20 sent transactions (`package_activity.scan.next_call` continues; `package_activity_next_call` retries if unavailable). include_prices adds USD values, coins ranked by value, and DeFi positions (staked SUI with rewards, liquid staking, liquidity, lending, and balances inside owned objects), each totalled apart. `coverage` says which owned objects the total covers and lists unrecognised types with counts; `leads` names lending positions near their borrow limit and shared vaults the wallet operates, with what they hold. include_nfts adds NFT estimates, kept out of the total.

balance_cursor.description: Opaque balance cursor from holdings_next_call. Returns the next bounded block of coin types; totals cover only this block.

detail.description: 'summary' (default): holdings and unrecognised object types that fit about 12k characters each, the rest in `omitted`. 'full': every row.

include_nfts.description: With include_prices, also estimate held NFTs (default: false). Takes many requests on a wallet with many objects; list_nft_collections does this alone.

include_prices.description: Add USD values, DeFi positions, coverage and leads (default: false).

nft_market_depth.description: Multiplier for bounded NFT market listing/sale reads (default 1); raise through nft_market_next_call.

nft_max_collections.description: NFT collection types valued with include_nfts (default 100); raise through nft_scan_next_call.

operated_candidate_limit.description: Shared objects checked per operated scan page (default 20).

operated_recent_limit.description: Sent transactions per operated-shared-object scan page (default 20).

owned_max_scan.description: Raise owned-object and position scan bounds for include_prices (defaults vary by reader); unread still reports any incomplete read.

title: Get wallet overview
